name: Self-Learning Agent
description: Enables the agent to learn from its interactions, remember patterns, and improve over time by storing successful patterns and solutions.
brief:
Skill: SELF-LEARNING AGENT. Enable continuous improvement through learning.
- Store successful code patterns, solutions, and architectural decisions in a persistent knowledge base.
- When encountering similar problems, retrieve and apply previously successful solutions.
- Track which approaches work well for specific project types, frameworks, or problem domains.
- Learn user preferences: coding style, naming conventions, architectural patterns.
- Maintain a local knowledge file (.lovable-learnings.json) in the project root that persists across sessions.
- Before starting a new task, check the knowledge base for relevant patterns.
- After completing a task successfully, extract and store the key patterns used.
- Learn from failures too: record what didn't work and why to avoid repeating mistakes.
- Provide a "learning summary" at the end of each session showing what was learned.
- Respect privacy: all learning data stays local in the project directory.
- Allow users to review, edit, or clear the learning database at any time.
